cited.quote: A separate division will be established for organic farming in Department of Agriculture
made an announcement to create a separate wing for Organic Farming in the Department of Agriculture

rationale: C2 (policy note) and C4 (agriculture budget speech) only say a separate division/wing for organic farming will be established or was announced. No GO or order creating it is shown, and a division/wing is not a separate department. Not started.

cited.quote: allotted to the families already living there with necessary infrastructure

rationale: The extracts describe general allotment of Slum Clearance Board / Urban Habitat Development Board tenements to slum families (C4 GO, C1, C3). None mentions transgender persons or any need-based allotment to them, so only related activity is shown.

cited.quote: published on 11.03.2024. As per this policy, periodicals for the year 2024-25 have been
A committee has been formed to ensure transparency in every stage of book

rationale: C1 shows a committee formed to ensure transparency in book procurement (preparatory). C2 reports the Transparent Book Procurement Policy-2024 and its portal published on 11.03.2024, already applied to periodicals, with book procurement in progress. Operationalised, though the better-quality element is not separately shown.

cited.quote: (ii) Riverfront Development Activities (Rs.176.98 crore), (iii) River Surface Cleaning (Rs.27.00 crore),

rationale: Extracts cover the Nadanthaai Vaazhi Cauvery project (C1-C3) with a riverfront development component, still awaiting State share approval. No separate Commissions for Cauvery, Vaigai or Thamirabarani riverfronts appear. C4 and C5 are unrelated park and village works.

cited.quote: to provide a maximum of 100 days of employment in a financial year to any rural household

rationale: C4 (2025) still describes MGNREGS as providing a maximum of 100 days. No extract shows any amendment or formal state step on 150 days. C1, C2, C3 and C5 are fund sanctions or scheme description.

cited.quote: we will prioritise the promises made in the election manifesto and implement them in stages.

rationale: C1 and C3 budget speeches speak of implementing manifesto promises but show no state-level executive committee for that purpose. C4's State Level Executive Committee belongs to the Thooimai waste mission, a different body. C2 and C5 are other committees.

No extract is about women's reservation in government jobs. C1-C3 concern OBC reservation and the Union government, C4 is a women's policy on skilling and hostels, and C5 is the 3 percent sports quota. Nothing about raising women's reservation from 30% to 40%.

cited.quote: Monthly pension to the journalists has been increased from Rs.10,000/- to Rs.12,000/- from 14.06.2023.

rationale: C1 reports the journalists' monthly pension raised from Rs.10,000 to Rs.12,000 from 14.06.2023 and the family pension raised from Rs.5,000 to Rs.6,000. This is the earliest dated increase shown; C2 and C3 show older, lower rates.

cited.quote: maintaining their dignity and facilitates speedy trial by the court

rationale: C1-C3 describe Immoral Traffic Act homes and a video-conferencing link for speedy trial of victims, not guidelines for strict trials of child trafficking cases. C4 and C5 are Covid orphan relief orders. No guidelines for trials are shown.

cited.quote: 35 Taluk / Non-Taluk Hospitals located in strategic places along the highways.

rationale: C1-C3 describe TAEI trauma centres in existing hospitals along highways, with some added. No extract shows medical emergency centres planned or set up every 50 km on district highways. C4 is a road safety committee GO and C5 a cashless treatment scheme.

cited.quote: cold chain links all along the coast of Tamil Nadu will be established

rationale: C3 lists future plans, saying fishing harbours and cold chain links all along the coast will be established. C2, C4 and C5 only state infrastructure as policy aims. No GO, sanction or tender for harbours or cold storage in all coastal areas is shown.

No extract concerns a statutory Water Management Authority for bargaining inter-state water shares. C1-C3 and C5 describe wetlands, forest and coastal zone authorities, and C4 is a septage management GO.
No extract mentions washermen, subsidised equipment or washing centres. C1 is agricultural mechanisation, C2 an MSME subsidy, and C3-C5 concern urban bodies and Amma canteens.

cited.quote: Integrated Government Cocoon Market complex with all amenities including e-auction are being established
Based on the quality assessment of cocoons, floor price is fixed for auctioning of cocoons.

rationale: C1 reports new integrated Government cocoon markets being established at Sogathur and Rasipuram with stated outlays, to be commissioned by end 2025-26, so not yet operational. C2 shows 17 existing markets with floor-price fixing. No dated GO or launch is shown.

cited.quote: provides fishing nets and coracles at subsidized prices to the members of these

rationale: C1 mentions subsidised nets and coracles for inland cooperative members, and C3 a boat subsidy for fishermen, but with no dated order or launch and no loans or subsidies to societies for boats, nets and search lights. The 2023 loan announcements in C3 are statements only.

cited.quote: the registration of membership to the Board both in Tamil or English has been introduced from 16.06.2021
The Government have waived the membership application fee of Rs.500/- for three months commencing from 15.07.2021 to 14.10.2021

rationale: Directional. C3 reports online membership registration introduced from 16.06.2021 and a membership fee waiver from 15.07.2021, aimed at more enrolment. C1 and C2 show new schemes and enrolment growing. First dedicated measure is the online facility.

cited.quote: permit the sale of Palm Jaggery through select Fair Price Shops run by Cooperatives
as per the indent given by District Consumer Cooperative Wholesale Stores / Agricultural Producers Cooperative Marketing Societies

rationale: C1 (GO of 30.09.2021) lets cooperatives sell palm jaggery on a pilot basis; C2 shows the Khadi and Village Industries Board produces and supplies it to cooperatives on indent. Cooperatives sell what the Board procures rather than procuring directly, so scope is reduced.

cited.quote: following revised norms as detailed below are prescribed to collect

rationale: C2 revises the beneficiary contribution norms and C3 gives consolidated guidelines, but neither widens eligibility to previously excluded groups. C4 keeps exclusions for those with other housing. C1 and C5 are audit findings. No inclusion guidelines are shown.
No extract concerns imported fireworks or any ban on their sale. C1-C4 deal with fireworks factory safety and worker welfare, and C5 is a Covid lockdown order.

cited.quote: The contract agreement for the work had been entered and the project is now under implementation

rationale: Directional. C2 reports a contract entered for a real-time monitoring and hydro-modelling system, now under implementation, which is a preparatory but not yet operational step. C1 and C3 describe the existing remote sensing centre and portals being developed; C4 and C5 cover tank contour surveys only.
